title: North Carolina dogwood blossom
done: The dogwood is the state flower of North Carolina.

steps.say: Dogwood flowers are white; we use yellow. The four big squares are the flower's four bracts. Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: a green square, a gap, a big yellow square, a gap, a green square.
Next row down, left to right: a big yellow square, 2 green squares, a big yellow square.
Next row down, left to right: past the big square, 2 green squares, past the big square.
Next row down, left to right: 2 gaps, a big yellow square.
Next row down, left to right: a green square, a gap, past the big square, a gap, a green square.
